description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Olathe, KS. This pivotal leadership role offers a competitive annual salary range of $75,000 - $85,000, providing an excellent opportunity for a skilled Registered Nurse to advance their career.

As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in supporting the Director of Nursing, overseeing daily clinical operations, and ensuring the delivery of exceptional patient care. We are particularly interested in candidates with an RN background who can bring strong clinical expertise and leadership to our team, contributing to a positive and high-quality environment for both residents and staff.
requirements: Previous leadership experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care

facilityType: A premier health and rehabilitation center
description: We are seeking a dedicated MDS Coordinator (RN Preferred) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Olathe, KS. In this vital role, you will be responsible for completing and submitting accurate Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessments, ensuring compliance with federal and state regulations, and contributing to comprehensive resident care planning. This position offers a crucial opportunity to impact patient outcomes through meticulous documentation and interdisciplinary collaboration.This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate of $32.00 - $36.00. We are looking for a professional who is passionate about quality care and thrives in a supportive team environment. If you are an experienced MDS professional looking for a rewarding opportunity, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Current RN license (preferred) or LPN license
Proven experience as an MDS Coordinator, preferably with MDS 3.0
Strong understanding of federal and state regulations related to MDS and care planning
Excellent assessment, documentation, and communication skills
Ability to work effectively within an interdisciplinary team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation is $32.00 - $36.00 per hour, based on experience.

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead our clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Des Moines, IA. This is a critical leadership opportunity for a compassionate and skilled RN to make a significant impact on patient care and operational excellence.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of care, and fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff. We are looking for a leader who can drive quality initiatives, manage clinical staff, and maintain regulatory compliance. This is a permanent, full-time position offering a competitive salary for a professional ready to take on a challenging yet rewarding role.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Proven experience as a Director of Nursing or in a similar nursing leadership role
Strong knowledge of long-term care regulations and compliance standards
Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and manage a diverse clinical team
Excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills
